New to Chalkline? Read the **Quick Start** to set up your course, then take the **tour**: every feature chip in it opens a working example.

**Getting new features:** run `python chalkline.py update` (or VS Code: **Terminal › Run Task… › Update Chalkline**). It updates Chalkline's files only; your lessons stay as they are. Commit your work first.
